_comment: Phone-number RBAC allowlist. Empty senders = bootstrap mode (log + process everyone, used only to discover real JIDs during initial linking -- watch run.log for BOOTSTRAP_UNKNOWN_SENDER lines). Once populated, only listed senders are processed; everyone else is silently dropped. Each entry: normalized WhatsApp JID -> Odoo identity. Copy this file to senders.json (gitignored, real personal data) and fill in real JIDs/uids before running.
